verdict.rationale: Vapi documents programmatic management of core resources: creating assistants via the SDK, and managing assistants, phone numbers and calls through the CLI and an MCP server that exposes Vapi APIs. It also supports inline (transient) assistant configurations. Nothing in the evidence states API–UI parity, and several workflows are documented only through the Dashboard, such as turning on HIPAA compliance and looking up voice IDs. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for dashboard-documented settings (HIPAA mode, voice lookup, org/RBAC/SSO admin), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Vapi MCP Server exposes Vapi APIs as tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so you can manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from any MCP-compatible AI assistant
Manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from your terminal
Choose between transient (inline) and permanent (stored) configurations to optimize your Vapi implementation
